title: My Gas Station Night Shift Came With 10 Rules. I Broke Rule 7.
description:
Sam took a night shift at a gas station on Route 9 for almost double the pay. Taped under the till was a list of rules in three different handwritings. Rule seven: never serve the man who pays in wet coins.
An original animated horror story (fiction).

scenes.text: My name is Sam, and for three weeks last winter I worked the night shift at a gas station on Route 9. I'm only telling this because the listing is up again. Same pay. Same words. No experience needed.

scenes.prompt: dark 2D animated horror illustration, flat cel shading, muted desaturated palette of sodium orange, sickly green and deep blue-black, heavy black shadows, thick clean outlines, film grain, cinematic 16:9 wide shot, no text, no words, no letters. a young night-shift clerk in a dark green vest, seen from behind or in silhouette, face hidden receiving a ring of keys from a nervous older owner in a heavy coat who is already turning to leave, gas station doorway at night
scenes.text: The pay was almost double anything else in town, and I was two months behind on rent. The owner, Mr. Hale, met me at ten at night, handed me the keys, and said the regulars were quiet. Then he left, fast, without checking a single thing I did.

scenes.prompt: dark 2D animated horror illustration, flat cel shading, muted desaturated palette of sodium orange, sickly green and deep blue-black, heavy black shadows, thick clean outlines, film grain, cinematic 16:9 wide shot, no text, no words, no letters. scenes.text: Under the till, taped to the wood, was a sheet of paper. Ten rules. Three different handwritings, like three different people had added to it over the years.

scenes.prompt: dark 2D animated horror illustration, flat cel shading, muted desaturated palette of sodium orange, sickly green and deep blue-black, heavy black shadows, thick clean outlines, film grain, cinematic 16:9 wide shot, no text, no words, no letters. scenes.text: Rule one: if a car pulls up with no headlights, do not look at the driver. Rule two: if anyone asks for the bathroom key, say it's broken. Rule seven was underlined twice. Never serve the man who pays in wet coins.

scenes.prompt: dark 2D animated horror illustration, flat cel shading, muted desaturated palette of sodium orange, sickly green and deep blue-black, heavy black shadows, thick clean outlines, film grain, cinematic 16:9 wide shot, no text, no words, no letters. a young night-shift clerk in a dark green vest, seen from behind or in silhouette, face hidden slouched behind the counter at 2 a.m. scrolling a phone, a wall clock reading two, the store empty and humming, dark windows
scenes.text: I laughed. I thought it was a prank for the new kid. I put the sheet back and didn't think about it again. Until two in the morning.

scenes.prompt: dark 2D animated horror illustration, flat cel shading, muted desaturated palette of sodium orange, sickly green and deep blue-black, heavy black shadows, thick clean outlines, film grain, cinematic 16:9 wide shot, no text, no words, no letters. scenes.text: The lights over the pumps flickered, all at once, and a black car rolled up to pump four. No headlights. I never heard an engine.

scenes.prompt: dark 2D animated horror illustration, flat cel shading, muted desaturated palette of sodium orange, sickly green and deep blue-black, heavy black shadows, thick clean outlines, film grain, cinematic 16:9 wide shot, no text, no words, no letters. a young night-shift clerk in a dark green vest, seen from behind or in silhouette, face hidden staring rigidly at a cigarette rack behind the counter, shoulders tense, while in the window reflection a dark car waits at the pump
scenes.text: I didn't look. I stared at the cigarette rack so hard my eyes watered, and I listened to the pump click and hum, click and hum, for almost ten minutes.

scenes.prompt: dark 2D animated horror illustration, flat cel shading, muted desaturated palette of sodium orange, sickly green and deep blue-black, heavy black shadows, thick clean outlines, film grain, cinematic 16:9 wide shot, no text, no words, no letters. scenes.text: When it stopped, the car was gone. The register showed no sale. But the nozzle was hanging back in its holster, dripping, and what dripped from it wasn't gas.

scenes.text: The next night, a woman in a thin summer dress asked for the bathroom key. It was January. Her feet were bare. I said it was broken. She smiled, too wide, and said: that's alright. I'll wait for the next one.

scenes.prompt: dark 2D animated horror illustration, flat cel shading, muted desaturated palette of sodium orange, sickly green and deep blue-black, heavy black shadows, thick clean outlines, film grain, cinematic 16:9 wide shot, no text, no words, no letters. a young night-shift clerk in a dark green vest, seen from behind or in silhouette, face hidden hunched over the counter at night re-reading the rules sheet under a single flickering tube light, store aisles fading into darkness
scenes.text: For two weeks, I followed every rule. I stopped laughing at them. And every night, I read rule seven. Because it was the only one that didn't say what would happen.

scenes.prompt: dark 2D animated horror illustration, flat cel shading, muted desaturated palette of sodium orange, sickly green and deep blue-black, heavy black shadows, thick clean outlines, film grain, cinematic 16:9 wide shot, no text, no words, no letters. a very tall gaunt man in a long black soaked coat, face shadowed by a wide brim hat standing just inside the gas station door, water streaming off him and pooling on the tile floor, dry night outside, fluorescent light buzzing
scenes.text: He came in on a Thursday, at three fifteen. Tall, long coat, soaked through, though it hadn't rained in a month. Water ran off him and pooled on the floor, and he didn't seem to notice.

scenes.text: He put a can of coffee on the counter. Then, one by one, he laid down coins. Old ones. Green with rust. Each one left a ring of water on the glass.

scenes.prompt: dark 2D animated horror illustration, flat cel shading, muted desaturated palette of sodium orange, sickly green and deep blue-black, heavy black shadows, thick clean outlines, film grain, cinematic 16:9 wide shot, no text, no words, no letters. scenes.text: I should have said no. But he looked so tired. His hands were shaking. And it was only coffee. So I took the coins. They were cold, colder than ice, and they kept dripping in the drawer.

scenes.prompt: dark 2D animated horror illustration, flat cel shading, muted desaturated palette of sodium orange, sickly green and deep blue-black, heavy black shadows, thick clean outlines, film grain, cinematic 16:9 wide shot, no text, no words, no letters. scenes.text: For the first time, he looked up at me. He smiled, and his mouth was full of black water. Thank you, he said. I've been waiting so long for someone new.

scenes.prompt: dark 2D animated horror illustration, flat cel shading, muted desaturated palette of sodium orange, sickly green and deep blue-black, heavy black shadows, thick clean outlines, film grain, cinematic 16:9 wide shot, no text, no words, no letters. scenes.text: When he left, I turned the sheet of rules over. There was an eleventh rule on the back that I'd never seen. The ink was still wet. If you served him, you are the night shift now.

scenes.prompt: dark 2D animated horror illustration, flat cel shading, muted desaturated palette of sodium orange, sickly green and deep blue-black, heavy black shadows, thick clean outlines, film grain, cinematic 16:9 wide shot, no text, no words, no letters. scenes.text: I called Mr. Hale. Somewhere behind me, a phone started ringing. It was the old phone under the counter. The one with its cord cut clean through.

scenes.prompt: dark 2D animated horror illustration, flat cel shading, muted desaturated palette of sodium orange, sickly green and deep blue-black, heavy black shadows, thick clean outlines, film grain, cinematic 16:9 wide shot, no text, no words, no letters. a young night-shift clerk in a dark green vest, seen from behind or in silhouette, face hidden walking along a foggy highway at grey dawn toward a gas station that sits directly ahead, the same station visible again behind them, impossible loop
scenes.text: At dawn, I grabbed my coat and pushed through the doors. I walked past pump four, toward the highway. And walked. And the gas station was in front of me again.

scenes.text: I don't know how long I've been here. The sun comes up, but it never quite reaches the store. The coins in the drawer are still wet.

scenes.text: So I wrote a new sheet of rules, for whoever answers the listing next. It's in my handwriting now. I added one at the bottom.
